limitations: First foliage OFF/ON pair is an occluded-source control: the oak obscures the bushes and the room blocks the low western sun.
Native saved-state 008 is a zero-light regression, not positive bounced-light evidence. CPU save regression also covers a lit open roof.
Native memory storage checks real WorldStorage logic but not disk persistence.
Static ON trials contain 22/15/7 frame intervals above 16.67ms, with one above33.33ms and max38.3ms; not a zero-stutter guarantee.
Isolated effect variants are single exploratory samples after paired trials; their differences are not additive.
OFF uses current 0.58.0 shaders and profile attributes; it is not an old 0.57.0 executable comparison.
The 180-second ON route has 371/22020 frame intervals above 16.67ms, 10 above 33.33ms, and max53ms. GPU percentiles have headroom, but ideal stable60 is not demonstrated.

The 180-second endpoint solver was still pending near the moving camera; typed arrays stayed fixed while estimated cache memory increased. Two memory snapshots cannot establish peak usage or long-session growth.
Final native foliage PNGs are1904x1041 while the WebGL drawing buffer and performance viewport are1920x1080; pixel coordinates refer to actual PNG pixels.
Final native foliage OFF/ON pair enables bounce/transmission/specular together. It confirms real image response but does not numerically isolate transmission.

Matched movement ON/OFF runs both include463 geometry changes. CPU median grows by1.1ms and budget-overrun frequency by0.745percentage points with effects ON; single-pair differences are not exact causal per-effect allocations.
Menu tour is functional coverage, not a formal FPS benchmark; camera sample counts are short and unequal, and terrain-ready does not imply bounce solver fully settled.
